title: Campus Bikes II
summary: Given a campus as a 2D grid with n workers and m bikes (n <= m), assign each worker a unique bike to minimize the total Manhattan distance between workers and their assigned bikes.
statement: Given a campus as a 2D grid with n workers and m bikes (n <= m), assign each worker a unique bike to minimize the total Manhattan distance between workers and their assigned bikes. Return the minimum total distance.
constraints: There are at least as many bikes as workers.
Assign distinct bikes to minimize total Manhattan distance.
hints: The worker index equals the number of selected bits, so state needs only the bike mask.
Try every unused bike for the next worker and memoize the minimum.
Add Manhattan distance plus the recursive cost with that bit set.
Every injective assignment corresponds to exactly one path through these states.
editorial: Every injective assignment corresponds to exactly one path through these states.

tests.explanation: Assign bikes zero and one respectively for distances three and three, total six.
The optimal one-to-one assignment totals four.
